Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarship

The scholarship is awarded to excellent students from outside the Netherlands who wish to pursue a Master's degree at TU Delft.

Who can apply

You are eligible if you are enrolling in a two-year MSc programme at TU Delft. The scholarship is not available for bachelor's programmes.

Value

CostStatus
TuitionCovered
HousingCovered
Living stipendCovered

How to apply

Candidates are nominated by the faculty. Direct applications are not accepted.
